mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (id, user_id, title, description, plan_date, plan_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{planDate}, #{planType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, plan_date, plan_type, created_at, updated_at FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY plan_date DESC, created_at DESC
